candidats.description: Main crossroads at Nordre Ringgade, Nørrebrogade and Randersvej by Nobelparken, Aarhus University. Dark blue sky and light, just before dawn, during typical commuter hours. January after overnight snow. Car lights seen in several directions. A cyclist just riding by, head down, dark clothing, wearing a helmet. The road for motorised vehicles has been cleared. The cycleway for bikes has been cleared.
